---
title: "Examples from the help file"
subtitle: "The examples at the end of help meinequality, run in full"
---
<<dd_version: 2>>

The examples from the end of the [help file](help.html), in order, on
Stata's `nlsw88` data.

## Single model

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
sysuse nlsw88, clear

reg wage i.race c.age i.married

meinequality race
meinequality race, unweighted
<</dd_do>>
```

## Compare across two models on the same sample

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
logit union i.race, vce(robust)
est store basemod
logit union i.race c.age i.married, vce(robust)
est store medmod

meinequality race, models(basemod medmod)
<</dd_do>>
```

## ME inequality by group

In the second model, with the **Diff.** row testing whether it differs
between the groups:

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
meinequality race, models(medmod) by(married)
<</dd_do>>
```

## Compare across distinct samples/groups for two models

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
logit union i.race c.age if married == 0, vce(robust)
est store notmar
logit union i.race c.age if married == 1, vce(robust)
est store marry

meinequality race, models(notmar marry) groups
<</dd_do>>
```

## Nominal or ordinal outcome models

One ME inequality is reported per outcome category.

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
mlogit industry i.race c.age

meinequality race
<</dd_do>>
```

## Bootstrap example

Wrap the model and the command in an r-class program and hand it to
`bootstrap`. (Shown, not run.)

```stata
capture program drop boot_mei

program define boot_mei, rclass
    reg wage i.race c.age i.married
    meinequality race
    return scalar w_mei = r(wem11)
end

bootstrap w_mei=r(w_mei), reps(1000): boot_mei
```
